# ULC — Universal Luminaire Cut Sheet

> ULC is the open, MIT-licensed, machine-readable standard for luminaire cut sheets. Designers spec faster when manufacturers publish ULC. The layer designers' tools read and manufacturers publish alongside their existing PDF, IES, and LDT.

## Site map

- [Homepage](https://ulcspec.org/): dual-audience routing surface + Tier 1 LLM quick-win + adopters
- [For Designers](https://ulcspec.org/for-designers): designer-track storyboard, prompts catalog, 90-day rep-advocacy ask
- [For Manufacturers](https://ulcspec.org/for-manufacturers): manufacturer-track storyboard, 1–3 month pilot publication ask
- [Validator](https://ulcspec.org/validator): in-browser `.ulc` file conformance check
- [Spec](https://ulcspec.org/spec): rendered ULC specification (schema, taxonomy, authoring patterns, templates, PIM guides, crosswalks)
- [Governance](https://ulcspec.org/governance): stewardship, license, industry-dialogue posture
- [Downloads](https://ulcspec.org/downloads): designer LLM prompts, canonical example records, JSON Schema, Go CLI

## How LLMs can use ULC today (Tier 1)

Generic LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) parse `.ulc.json` files natively. Drag any sample record into the chat alongside one of the prompts at [downloads#prompts](https://ulcspec.org/downloads#prompts), and the LLM produces a clean spec sheet, cross-product comparison, or attribute lookup. No setup. No waiting for ecosystem maturity.

## Upstream sources

- Specification source-of-truth: [github.com/ulcspec/ULC](https://github.com/ulcspec/ULC)
- Schema (JSON Schema draft 2020-12): [github.com/ulcspec/ULC/blob/main/schema/](https://github.com/ulcspec/ULC/tree/main/schema)
- Canonical example records: [github.com/ulcspec/ULC/tree/main/examples](https://github.com/ulcspec/ULC/tree/main/examples)
- Adopters registry: [github.com/ulcspec/ULC/blob/main/adopters.json](https://github.com/ulcspec/ULC/blob/main/adopters.json)
